Definition: Beriah, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Beriah means "with a friend." The name is shared by several bearers: A son of Asher; A son of Ephraim; A Benjamite; A Levite. It turns up in Genesis 46:17, Numbers 26:44 and Numbers 26:45.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Beriah is in Scripture for a reason, and no name there is an accident.
